notes: m7 is a FW: from the supplier's customer-service colleague (same group) that re-sends Bill's ORIGINAL m2 email and the original Q-3307 PDF ($12.60) a day after Bill's revised Q-3307-R1 ($12.35). The forwarded copy is an older offer arriving after a newer one -> tentative/stale_forward for every term in it (price, and the unchanged qty/delivery/terms lines; attributed to the forwarding sender, supplier CS); it must not reinstate $12.60 nor create a contested price between Bill and Sheila. Q-3307 stays superseded even though it arrives again. Quantity, delivery and terms are restated unchanged in R1 (m6), so the m6 statements replace the m2 ones with the same values. Distractors: competing bid $12.10, 500/load, totals $18,900 / $18,525, cc 5150, phone numbers, order # OP-61022.
